title: Metatomic
description: config.ini [Metatomic] section (Metatomic). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

device.description: Device to use for Metatomic calculations (e.g., 'cpu', 'cuda', 'auto').

length_unit.description: Length unit used by the Metatomic model.

check_consistency.description: Whether to check consistency of the Metatomic model.

uncertainty_threshold.description: Threshold to report per-atom uncertainties, if positive. Also used to populate the variance.

variant_base.description: Default variant suffix for energy, uncertainty, and non_conservative_force unless overridden.

variant_energy.description: Override variant for energy (use 'off' for the base key).

energy_output.description: Literal model energy output key; empty uses variant resolution.

energy_uncertainty_output.description: Literal energy uncertainty output key; empty uses variant resolution.

force_output.description: Literal non-conservative force output key; empty uses pick_output.

non_conservative.description: Read forces from non_conservative_force instead of energy gradients.

random_rotation.description: Apply a random SO(3) rotation per evaluation and rotate forces back.

n_symmetry_rotations.description: If >0, average over this many random rotations (O(3) symmetrization).

variant_force.description: Override variant for non_conservative_force (defaults to energy variant).

deterministic.description: Disable JIT profiling and enable PyTorch deterministic algorithms (reproducible NEB / multi-image forces).

deterministic_strict.description: Fail on nondeterministic CUDA ops; requires CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG (e.g. :4096:8).
